node.title: Constant-projection singleton and rich-fibre census for original MCA raw weights
node.statement: Actual original pair fibres of one nonzero original-field constant projection have a singleton/rich census Omega_t<=t+(n-A)Q(n-A)+sum uP(l)Q(u). Two distinct pairs force complement at most n-2A+K-1. Outside original raw weights are bounded per pair; inside defects use one globally unique preferred label. The projected image may have dimension greater than one; no shared packing or anchor assumption is used.
